findings.description: Using `all` suppresses the entire positional arguments section when any argument lacks help, instead of listing every argument when at least one is documented.
findings.rationale: For a command with two arguments, one with help text and one with `help=None`, this condition evaluates to false and skips rendering both records. Users lose the documented argument's help and never see the intended exhaustive list. The guard should check whether any argument is documented; this would also avoid entering the section for an empty argument list.
